title: Replace your registered surveyor identity card
summary: You can order a replacement registered surveyor identity card online if your current card has been lost, damaged, destroyed, or stolen.
intro:
If your registered surveyor ID card (certificate of authority) has been lost, damaged, destroyed or stolen, you can order a replacement online.

To check your licence or registration details visit Verify NSW.
who_can_apply: You can apply for a replacement ID card online if your name or address details have not changed since your last ID card was issued.
If your details have changed, you must complete the online form to update your contact details.
what_you_need: Your surveyor licence or registration number
A passport quality photo in JPG format
A credit or debit card to pay the replacement fee

how_to_steps.text: Follow the prompts to apply for a replacement identity card.

external_links.text: Board of Surveying and Spatial Information (BOSSI)

faqs.q: Where can I check my licence or registration details?
faqs.a: You can check your licence or registration details by visiting Verify NSW.

faqs.q: What do I do if my name or address details have changed?
faqs.a: If your details have changed, you must complete the online form to update your contact details before applying for a replacement card.

faqs.q: What do I need to replace my identity card?
faqs.a: You need your surveyor licence or registration number, a passport quality photo in JPG format, and a credit or debit card to pay the replacement fee.
